editorial.blurb: This humble River North counter-service spot delivers authentic, flavorful momos and Indian-Nepalese dishes that punch well above their casual dive aesthetic.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the chili chicken momo extra spicy if you want actual heat; ask for the Chiola momo with chicken for deep, complex flavors, and pair with a mango lassi.

topDishes.note: Genuinely spicy and packed with flavor when ordered extra spicy
